eucalyptus_leaf

red_japanese_maple

orange_sugar_maple

olive_branch
Olive Branch: diagonally rising elegant branch with six smooth slender silver green pointed oval leaves and two deep purple olives, compact balanced silhouette.
rosemary_branch
Rosemary Branch: single gently curved woody sprig with dense short narrow green needle leaves and two tiny lilac blossoms, compact upright silhouette.
